scope: Local isolated objective and fitting-log implementation; no real trainer integration
first_hit_semantics: At least one epsilon-near-optimal action in first 10
negative_count_less_than_K: Guaranteed hit; zero differentiable signal, keep macro denominator and mark explicitly
ties: Exact logs use score descending then UID ascending; strict positive gap is a sufficient hit certificate, zero gap is not
positive_selection: Maximum positive score: optimizes ANY positive, not all positives; active positive can switch
score_scale: No tuned margin or temperature; retain unit softplus, no guarantee of calibration
remaining_gates: Actual torch forward/backward versus reference on generated fixtures in an authorized isolated runtime
Fresh explicit real-training release if a controlled comparison is requested
claim_boundary: Head objective reflects first-hit rank boundary; synthetic tests do not prove real optimization convergence, transfer improvement, or ATPG cost reduction.
